main.description: One author's hidden posts for one group of people. The author is the space authority; the space is a memberspace (or a personalspace for only-me) whose member list is published to members only. A group's key is a TID; a private account's approved followers use the key followers; only-me uses the key self. Special keys: self (only me), followers (a private account's approved followers), everyone (everyone with Umbrae, a managedspace), community (a community: the authority is the community's own account and the space is a managedspace, its managing app holding membership), profile (the owner's one hidden profile: a memberspace with no members, read by the owner's serving app).
main.title: Umbrae hidden posts
